policies.using:
((get_auth_role() = ANY (ARRAY['manager'::text, 'assistant_manager'::text, 'store_manager'::text])) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM booking_orders bo
  WHERE ((bo.id = booking_attendees.booking_order_id) AND (bo.branch_id = get_auth_branch_id())))))
